name: Example: Computing the Probability That a Discrete Random Variable Lies Within an Interval
problem:
| $x$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $P(X=x)$ | $\dfrac{1}{5}$ | $\dfrac{3}{10}$ | $\dfrac{1}{10}$ | $\dfrac{2}{5}$ |

Compute $P\left( X \leq 3 \right)$ given that the random variable $X$ has the probability mass function shown in the table above.
worked_solution:
Using the values in the table, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\le 3) & =P(x\in {1,2,3}) \\  & =P(X=1)+P(X=2)+P(X=3) \\  & =\frac{1}{5}+\frac{3}{10}+\frac{1}{10} \\  & =\frac{3}{5}.\end{aligned}
$$
